runtime_context.classification: Fresh-profile skill/native-API comparison; no global or project AGENTS instructions injected
runtime_context.working_directory: unique neutral directory per participant outside the repository
runtime_context.launch: codex --no-daemon exec, project_doc_max_bytes=0, features.memories=false; exact argv and context hashes retained locally
runtime_context.timing: One complete participant turn, including skill/API loading and task configuration. Profile provisioning, app launch, host process startup/shutdown, coordinator audit and cleanup are outside this timer.
runtime_context.limits: Same macOS user session, permissions, Launch Services, native CUA service/runtime assets and system caches; no VM/reboot/cache flush. Fresh profile, neutral cwd, exact disposable app identity and initial app state per participant.
runtime_context.comparison_scope: Two paired wizard datasets targeting the previously observed recovery overhead. Previous clean block is historical, not randomized before/after evidence; do not pool with repository-context blocks.

change_scope.description: Return and register the already-read current snapshot when rejecting a stale ref; capture published recovery state from either output stream without a success/wait special case. Compact recovery observations use the same presentation as successful state. Skill reuses attached state and observes unfamiliar navigation before predicting waits. No additional AX read, runtime check, retry, fixed sleep or task-specific solver.
